description.value: Sushi Oyama is a Japanese restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby offering a broad menu of sushi, sashimi, nigiri, rolls, donburi, noodles, and hot pot. The restaurant emphasises globally sourced fresh ingredients and precision-crafted rolls. Online ordering is available for takeout.
